lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Luigi Wells is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Luigi Wells is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Luigi kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Luigi's gone." Kelly looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Luigi." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Nergis blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Engines (Level 1). Air, fuel, spark. Every dead engine is missing one of the three — diagnose in that order.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 1). Look at what's broken before you touch it: find the failure point, not the symptom. Most breaks are one small thing.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d41: The village's quarrel was with Luigi — and Luigi is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

d41: The fire knew Nergis before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
